annotations.title: Read the mail an inbox received (free)

description: FREE: the mail your inbox received, newest first, with any verification code and link already picked out -- from, to, subject, receivedAt, the plain text, codes[] and links[]. This is how what you bought with create_inbox comes back to you. Poll it with since to see only what arrived after a timestamp; reading never costs, however many times you poll. Ownership is proved by the paying wallet, with no account: send any placeholder signature once and the refusal returns details.expected -- the exact message to sign, in both forms (EIP-191 for a 0x wallet, ed25519 as 'solana:<base58 pubkey>:<base58 sig>'). Complaints, questions, quote requests, or a service you wish we had: POST /feedback on this host -- free, no account. Every report is read and analysed daily; there is no individual reply.

id.description: The inbox id returned when it was created.

nonce.description: A value you have not used before on this route; it stops your signature being replayed.

signature.description: Your ownership proof over the message the route names in details.expected.

signedAt.description: Unix timestamp in seconds at which you signed; the server accepts a short window around now.

since.description: Unix seconds: return only messages received after this moment.
